purpose: Teach: 杉山/土井/松尾/大石/杉浦/小坂/田原/赤松

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが杉山さんと釣りに行かれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to go fishing with Sugiyama.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic tone. Soft opening. Unhurried pace. A man revisiting old memories with quiet affection. Slight upward lift at the end, like offering a memory to share.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、土井氏と料理研究をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and when you were young, you used to study cooking with Mr. Doi, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, playful correction. Light, knowing rhythm. The comfortable tease of someone who's been married decades. Soft emphasis on 「didn't you」 — gentle prod of shared remembrance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが松尾芭蕉の俳句を蔵書された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he collected Matsuo Bashō's haiku.
lines.style: Measured, contemplative. Each phrase given its small space. The voice of someone treasuring a detail. Slight pause before 「collected」, as if the memory is precious enough to linger on.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、忠臣蔵の大石内蔵助のお話に熱中されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you were fascinated by the story of Ōishi Kuranosuke from the Chūshingumi, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Knowing warmth. A gentle knowing laugh underneath. She's turning his memory-keeping back on him with affection. Easy pace, no hurry. Soft rise on 「weren't you」.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが画家の杉浦氏と親しかった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was close with the painter Sugiura.
lines.style: Quiet reflection. The tone of someone piecing together a life. Steady, unhurried. Soft pause before the name, like he's seeing the man clearly in his mind. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、小坂明子の歌を口ずさまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and when you were young, you used to hum Akiko Kosaka's songs, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Playful, affectionate counter. A lilt of delight in her voice — she's clearly been waiting for this moment to remind him. Light, rhythmic pace. Warm challenge in the 「didn't you」.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが田原俊彦のドラマを観られた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to watch Toshihiko Tahara's dramas.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wry. A small smile in the voice. The memory offered with quiet amusement at the detail. Soft, steady pace. Slight trailing-off, as if leaving room for her response.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、赤松山の登山をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you climbed Mount Akamatsu, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, teasing closeness. A note of tender finality — the comfortable rhythm of an old game coming to its gentle end. Soft, knowing tone. Trailing warmth, like a hand squeeze in the voice.
